network.title: Network
network.readRelaysHint: Finds a first contact sooner. Relays see which keys it looks up.
network.readRelaysInfo: This app reads the Mainline DHT directly. With this on, it also reads through the Pkarr relays below.
network.relaysHint: One per line. They only see signed, encrypted packets.
network.relaysInfoDirect: Contacts on the web and in the extension cannot reach the Mainline DHT and read through relays, so this app writes to them too.
network.relaysInfoWeb: Browsers cannot reach the Mainline DHT directly, so relays do it for them. They never carry your messages, calls or services. Every relay listed is used.
network.turnHint: Optional. Used only when a direct connection fails.
network.turnInfo: It forwards encrypted WebRTC packets. It is connectivity infrastructure, not a Ghostly server.
network.irohHint: Used when WebRTC cannot connect. One per line, up to four.
network.irohInfo: A browser cannot send the UDP packets Iroh uses, so Iroh chats here go through a relay. It sees which devices talk and when, never what they say: the connection is encrypted end to end.
network.hyperdhtHint: Optional fallback when WebRTC fails. Empty: WebRTC only.
network.hyperdhtInfo: Lets chats use HyperDHT from this browser. The relay forwards encrypted bytes: it sees your address and when you talk, never what you say.
network.domainLookupsHint: Checks contacts' domain proofs. The resolver sees which domain.
network.domainLookupsInfo: When a contact shares a domain proof, this app looks up its record through {{name}}, a DNS-over-HTTPS resolver. It learns which domain was looked up and when, never your chats. Proofs published as a file on a website are downloaded from that website, which sees your IP address.
